title: Cones and Spheres
summary: Slant height, surface area and volume of cones, spheres and hemispheres, and Archimedes' ratio.

cbse.chapter: Ganita Manjari (2026): Mensuration: Surface Area and Volume
Earlier NCERT: Surface Areas and Volumes

objectives: I can find the slant height, surface area and volume of a cone.
I can find the surface area and volume of spheres and hemispheres.
I can solve real problems with composite solids.
misconceptions: A cone's volume equals the cylinder's.
Surface area of a hemisphere is 2πr² (for a solid one).
Doubling the radius doubles the volume.
